title: Judge Individuals, Not Groups
description: When evaluating groups: - Ask yourself: "Am I judging the group based on one person’s actions?" - Separate individuals: Focus on specific behaviors or contributions, not stereotypes. - Avoid sweeping judgments: Base evaluations on evidence, not generalizations. Example: If one team member underperforms, don’t assume the whole team is inefficient.
